note: The suite does not do routing itself - it delegates to the runner that owns it and carries the verdict back. The runner here is a stub that fails on purpose: what is under test is the wiring and the static/live split, not the routing. The runner lives in the fixture, so the case carries `--trust-target`: without it the suite refuses to execute a script out of the tree it was pointed at, which is the corpus exercising the opt-in as well as the routing wiring.
